findings.title: Collaboration/shared-source artifacts written plaintext to Firestore
findings.recommendation: Seal body/title/relativePath with path-bound AAD; replace keyless contentHash with vault-keyed HMAC; else disclose in UX.

findings.title: macOS crash-telemetry scrubber + per-install ID lack unit test
findings.recommendation: Add MacSentryScrubberTests mirroring iOS cases.

findings.title: CloudVault path-bound AAD only partially enforced
findings.recommendation: Migrate remaining writers to path-bound AAD then tighten rules.

findings.title: Local SQLite plaintext at rest (SQLCipher not vendored)
findings.recommendation: Vendor SQLCipher amalgamation (SQLITE_HAS_CODEC) to deliver at-rest encryption; do not imply it until then.

findings.title: accountDeletion.ts logs full UID + storage path via raw console.warn
findings.recommendation: Route through logWarn or hash UID; add to privacy-invariant gate scan.

findings.title: buildFcmMessage push ships stable thread_id correlator
findings.recommendation: Add buildFcmMessage to I5 gate or document/rotate the correlator.

findings.title: SSRF guard misses IPv4 alt-encodings + DNS rebinding
findings.recommendation: Resolve DNS and re-check resolved IP; integer-parse host before range checks, before any user-supplied-URL fetch ships.

findings.title: Legacy /var/run privileged bridge writes login password without client-side server-peer auth
findings.recommendation: Add validateServerPeer/getpeereid before the write.

findings.title: Executable resolution via login shell (zsh -lic) PATH/dotfile-hijackable
findings.recommendation: Use absolute-path allowlist exclusively for privileged/daemon resolution.

findings.title: RestrictedLogPathValidator tilde mismatch + no canonicalization
findings.recommendation: Expand both sides + standardizingPath/resolvingSymlinksInPath before prefix test.

findings.title: Android diff-coverage retains presence-based fallback path
findings.recommendation: Make Android presence path exit 1 outside CI.

findings.title: CODEOWNERS lacks explicit rules for security-sensitive trees
findings.recommendation: Add explicit path rules for functions/src/security, crypto, billing, scripts/ci, Vendor/libsignal.

findings.title: Client-mirrored quota counters allow <=1h under-report window
findings.recommendation: Gate consuming feature on server-reconciled billing/allowances or shorten reconcile interval.

findings.title: Account-deletion root-collection coverage is a static allowlist
findings.recommendation: CI test enumerating uid-keyed root collections vs deletion allowlist.

findings.title: Operator ops/** reads lack application-layer audit trail
findings.recommendation: Emit audit event on operator-scoped reads or accept platform logs.

findings.title: GPG checksum signing best-effort (skips if key absent)
findings.recommendation: Fail closed or warn loudly when RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY absent.

findings.title: LLM/agentic threat-model doc understates current controls
findings.recommendation: Refresh doc to match default-deny wrap + deny-region + leaf-kill code.

findings.title: Daemon T-DMN-04 local-auth-proof verifier nil in prod
findings.recommendation: Activate once pairing-key store exists; primary peer code-sign gate already enforced.

findings.title: Legacy no-token Apple S2S fallback attribution
findings.recommendation: Retire once all live subs carry appAccountToken.

findings.title: Mission-event metadata length side-channel + import error path leak
findings.recommendation: Drop/quantize length; path-strip import error.
